project.name: Summit Wealth Account Opening
project.description: Online account opening for individual investors and revocable trusts at a US wealth manager, replacing paper forms.

documents.title: Workshop - Financial advisors
documents.masked_text:
Advisor workshop notes
Advisors want to start an application on behalf of a client and send it to the client to finish and e-sign.
Clients should be able to link their external bank account for funding during onboarding.
The application must collect the client's employment status, net worth and investment objectives for suitability.
Accounts for existing clients should open instantly without repeating identity checks.
New accounts must be created in the portfolio accounting mainframe, which only accepts files twice a day.

documents.title: Email - BSA/AML officer
documents.masked_text:
Dana: Our CIP requires that we collect name, date of birth, address and SSN or TIN before opening any account.
Identity must be verified through a documentary or non-documentary method within 5 business days of account opening.
For trusts, we must identify the trustees and verify the identity of each trustee.
All new clients must be checked against the OFAC SDN list before the account is opened.
SAR decisions must be documented and SARs filed within 30 days of detection.

documents.title: IT security standards excerpt
documents.masked_text:
Client sessions must expire after 15 minutes of inactivity.
SSNs must be encrypted at rest and displayed masked except for the last four digits.
Advisors must authenticate with phishing-resistant MFA.
The system should log all access to client records for at least 7 years.

questions.question: Regarding FR-KYC-001 ("Clients should be able to link their external bank account for funding during onboarding."): Vague term(s): should be able to. Replace with measurable criteria.

Regarding FR-KYC-003 ("Accounts for existing clients should open instantly without repeating identity checks."): 'Instant' is not measurable; state a latency bound. Agree a realistic, measurable target.
What business outcome should the new onboarding deliver, and how will you measure it (e.g. completion rate, time-to-onboard, cost per KYC)?
Who will use the onboarding journey and back-office screens (customer segments, staff roles), and what can each role do?
Walk me through how onboarding and KYC are done today. Where are the manual steps, hand-offs and delays?
What should happen when something goes wrong, such as a vendor timeout, name mismatch, blurred document or partial sanctions match?
How long must KYC data, documents, video recordings and biometric templates be kept, and when must they be deleted?
Are there account or transaction limits tied to the KYC level (for example minimum-KYC or small accounts) before full verification is complete?
Which audit trails, regulatory reports and MIS dashboards are required, and who consumes them?
What are the response-time, throughput, peak-load and availability expectations for onboarding?
Which internal systems and external services must onboarding integrate with (core banking, CRM, screening vendor, KYC registry, e-sign)?
Which jurisdictions and regulations apply, and are there open audit findings or regulator observations on KYC?
What is the target go-live date, budget envelope and team capacity, and is there a regulatory deadline?

risks.title: Mandatory KYC controls not requested by stakeholders
risks.description: 11 mandatory controls were absent from stakeholder input and were derived from the control catalogue: KYC-C03, KYC-C04, KYC-C06, KYC-C07, KYC-C08, KYC-C09, KYC-C10, KYC-C12, KYC-C17, KYC-C19, KYC-C20.
risks.mitigation: Compliance officer validates derived requirements before baseline; include them in sprint 0 scope.

risks.title: Threat T-DOC-UPLOAD
risks.description: Tampering / Elevation: Malicious file uploaded as an identity document.
risks.mitigation: Implement linked security requirements; verify with threat-model review, SAST/DAST and penetration test.

risks.title: Threat T-SPOOF-BIO
risks.description: Spoofing: Presentation or injection attacks (photos, masks, deepfakes, virtual cameras) during remote verification.
risks.mitigation: Implement linked security requirements; verify with threat-model review, SAST/DAST and penetration test.

risks.title: Threat T-BIO-PRIV
risks.description: Information disclosure: Biometric data misuse or over-retention.
risks.mitigation: Implement linked security requirements; verify with threat-model review, SAST/DAST and penetration test.

risks.title: Threat T-STAFF
risks.description: Elevation of privilege / Repudiation: Insider misuse of customer identity data.
risks.mitigation: Implement linked security requirements; verify with threat-model review, SAST/DAST and penetration test.

risks.title: Threat T-ACCOUNT-TAKEOVER
risks.description: Spoofing: OTP brute force, SIM-swap and account-takeover during onboarding.
risks.mitigation: Implement linked security requirements; verify with threat-model review, SAST/DAST and penetration test.

risks.title: Threat T-SYNTHETIC
risks.description: Spoofing: Synthetic identities and mule-account onboarding at scale.
risks.mitigation: Implement linked security requirements; verify with threat-model review, SAST/DAST and penetration test.

risks.title: Threat T-DOS
risks.description: Denial of service: Volumetric attacks exhausting verification-vendor quotas or onboarding capacity.
risks.mitigation: Implement linked security requirements; verify with threat-model review, SAST/DAST and penetration test.

risks.title: Threat T-AI
risks.description: Repudiation / Fairness: Opaque or biased automated KYC decisions.
risks.mitigation: Implement linked security requirements; verify with threat-model review, SAST/DAST and penetration test.

risks.title: Threat T-NONPROD
risks.description: Information disclosure: Real KYC data leaking into test and analytics environments.
risks.mitigation: Implement linked security requirements; verify with threat-model review, SAST/DAST and penetration test.

risks.title: Legacy core-banking integration
risks.description: Account creation depends on legacy core banking interfaces (batch windows, limited APIs) that may break real-time onboarding targets.
risks.mitigation: Spike in sprint 1; asynchronous account creation with status callbacks; contract tests against a CBS simulator.

risks.title: Verification-vendor dependency
risks.description: Outage or degradation of identity, screening or registry vendors stops onboarding.
risks.mitigation: Dual-vendor strategy or graceful queueing; vendor SLAs and exit plan; circuit breakers.

risks.title: Biometric data breach
risks.description: Compromise of face images or templates is irreversible for customers.
risks.mitigation: Template protection, encryption with HSM keys, minimal retention, DPIA.

risks.title: Ambiguous or untestable requirements
risks.description: 7 requirements are vague or incomplete, which risks scope creep and failed UAT.
risks.mitigation: Resolve the clarification questions before the baseline gate.

risks.title: Automated adverse decisions without human review
risks.description: Fully automated rejection may breach automated-decision rules and fairness expectations.
risks.mitigation: Human review for rejections; reason codes; contest channel.
